mfg1-electrical-l098.title: Board manufacturing stages at order of magnitude
mfg1-electrical-l098.objective: Ihiwalay ang structure, process films, at machining scale.

paragraphs.title: Board role at heat
paragraphs.text: Motherboard ang main connection ng CPU, memory, at iba pa. Metal-base board combines metal, insulating layer, copper conductor para sa heat. Hindi ibig sabihing directly conductive ang pattern sa metal base. Ihiwalay ang single/double/multilayer sa usage name.

paragraphs.title: Sequence
paragraphs.text: Sa conceptual subtractive copper-clad process, may cutting, drilling/copper plating, photo-film, exposure/development, etching. Iba ang solder resist, silkscreen, surface treatment, outline/V-cut, inspection; tingnan ang actual method order. Huwag same-stage ang circuit photo-film at final solder resist.

paragraphs.title: Chemical processing at scale
paragraphs.text: Wet etch ay chemical unwanted-copper removal, hindi mechanical polishing. Kontrolin ang concentration, temperature, cleaning. Textbook compares submillimeter board at nm semiconductor, ngunit hindi fixed width ng lahat.1 mm=10⁶nm; kaya tiyakin ang unit/order.

terms.meaning: Film sa board na tumatakip at nagpoprotekta sa bahaging hindi lalagyan ng solder at iba pa.

mfg1-electrical-l098.activity:
Gabay na 30 minuto: 10 pag-unawa sa teksto, 8 pag-aayos ng halimbawa, 9 pagsulat, 3 pagbalik-tanaw.
Ihiwalay ang photo-film, solder resist, silkscreen sa layunin. I-convert ang 0.1 mm sa nm at ihiwalay ang textbook scale comparison sa individual design.
safety: Tiyakin ang qualification, training, duty scope, at aprubadong procedure sa equipment operation, measurement, machining, o setting change.
mfg1-electrical-l098.summary: Sa board stages/magnitude, tingnan ang structure, gamit, applicability, bukod sa pangalan.
